plan.description: The purpose of this QA test plan is to ensure that the Mawdoo3 website functions as intended, providing accurate information and a seamless user experience. This plan outlines the testing objectives, scope, approach, and test cases.
- Verify that the website is accessible and functional across different devices and browsers.
- Ensure that content is accurate and up-to-date.
- Validate the performance and loading speed of the website.
- Confirm that all links and navigation elements work correctly.
- Test the search functionality for accuracy and relevance.
- Operating Systems: Windows, macOS, iOS, Android
#### Test Case 1: Verify Homepage Load and Content Display
**Test Case Title:** Verify Homepage Load and Content Display
**Test Case Description:** Ensure that the homepage of Mawdoo3.com loads successfully and displays the expected content without errors.
- User has access to the internet.
- User has a compatible web browser installed.
3. Observe the loading time of the homepage.
4. Verify that all sections of the homepage are displayed correctly (e.g., header, main content, footer).
5. Check for any broken images or links on the homepage.
6. Ensure that the text content is legible and formatted correctly.
- The homepage should load within 3 seconds.
- All sections of the homepage should be displayed without any errors.
- No broken images or links should be present.
- Text content should be clear, correctly formatted, and free of spelling or grammatical errors.
- The homepage is accessible and functional for users.
- Record any issues encountered during testing for further investigation.

This test case serves as a foundational check for the overall functionality and user experience of the Mawdoo3 website. Additional test cases can be developed for more specific features and functionalities as needed.
